title: VTN Membership — Acknowledge — payload
description: A listed party's acknowledgement of a network's membership offer. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

acknowledgement.description: The party's membership credential, issued by the requester to the network, carrying the `digestMultibase` of the offer it acknowledges.

Response.title: VTN Membership — Acknowledge — response payload
Response.description: The party's entry as now published, with the network's signed grant and the party's acknowledgement.
